verdicts.evidence: SKILL.md line 16: "The constitution lives at `docs/global/project/constitution.md` — the single canonical path every downstream skill reads from. Don't invent a variant location."
verdicts.reasoning: Output paths are normally load-bearing invocation arguments, but this is the exception: the skill hardcodes the path as invariant and explicitly forbids any variant, so naming the same fixed path in the KICKOFF text adds zero optionality — it restates a hard rule the skill already enforces on every run. Verified the quote exists verbatim at line 16 and the same restatement recurs in the milestone-2+ block (lines 46-53). Harmless, so low severity stands.

verdicts.evidence: SKILL.md line 38: "- If user input (conversation) supplies a value, use it." and line 40: "...RATIFICATION_DATE is the original adoption date (if unknown ask or mark TODO)..." — these are the only two hits anywhere in SKILL.md or constitution-template.md for ask/interview/question/elicit/clarify/conversation/dialogue/solicit.
verdicts.reasoning: Ran an exhaustive case-insensitive grep across both files in the constitution skill directory (no references/ chain exists per the asset metadata) for ask, interview, question, elicit, clarify, prompt the, conversation, dialogue, solicit. The only hits are the passive 'if conversation already supplies a value, use it' clause and one date field's narrow 'ask or mark TODO' fallback. There is no step anywhere instructing the model to run a general elicitation/interview pass over the constitution's principles. On a greenfield milestone-1 repo with no prior conversation and no repo docs to infer from, the skill as written would fall straight to TODO placeholders for most principles. The KICKOFF's 'interview me' is therefore load-bearing behavior the skill does not itself contain — a genuine gap, confirmed after a real hunt, not assumed.

verdicts.evidence: SKILL.md (whole file) and constitution-template.md: zero occurrences of 'PROJECT.md' anywhere (grep confirmed).
verdicts.reasoning: The constitution skill's file scope is exactly one file (constitution.md); it never mentions PROJECT.md at all. The KICKOFF sentence assigning 'write docs/global/project/PROJECT.md: what this project is...' is an additional operator-assigned deliverable riding in the same prompt block, entirely outside what this skill does or could know. Genuinely load-bearing, not duplication.

verdicts.evidence: SKILL.md lines 25-27: "Your job is to (a) collect/derive concrete values, (b) fill the template precisely, and (c) propagate any amendments across dependent artifacts."
verdicts.reasoning: Verified this near-verbatim match to the KICKOFF's 'propagate the amendments to dependent docs' exists in the skill's own charter statement. It is then operationalized as the five-item 'Consistency propagation checklist' (step 4, lines 53-58 — confirmed 5 sub-items: plan template, spec template, tasks template, sibling SDD skills, runtime guidance docs) and reported in the Sync Impact Report's 'Templates requiring updates' field (line 65). verdicts.evidence: SKILL.md lines 94-95: "Do not create a new template; always operate on the project's constitution file (initializing it from `constitution-template.md` only when it does not exist)." Also lines 19-20 state the same existence-branching on first read.
verdicts.reasoning: Verified the quote exists verbatim at line 94 and that the skill already branches unconditionally on file existence at two points (19-20 and 94-95), so 'do not re-initialize it from the template' restates an already-unconditional rule. Also verified the claim's secondary point: grepped 'mode' (word-boundary) across both skill files and got zero hits — the skill has no notion of modes at all, so 'amend mode' does not correspond to a mode the skill offers (which would otherwise be the sanctioned mode-selection exception). Both halves of the reasoning check out.

verdicts.evidence: SKILL.md lines 99-100: "After the constitution is written, suggest the next phase: run the `specify` skill to turn a feature description into a specification that the constitution now governs."
verdicts.reasoning: Verified the quote exists verbatim; the skill's only handoff statement points at `specify` and never mentions spec-miner or doc-ingest — it has no knowledge of those sibling assets at all. Deciding whether to skip the spec-miner/doc-ingest blocks that follow in the guide is cross-asset orchestration judgement the constitution skill cannot make. Genuinely load-bearing.

verdicts.evidence: SKILL.md line 38: "- If user input (conversation) supplies a value, use it." — plus a whole-file grep for 'milestone' returning zero hits in SKILL.md or constitution-template.md.
verdicts.reasoning: Verified the skill has no milestone concept whatsoever (zero hits), so '<M>' is a per-milestone substitution only the operator can supply, and the PROJECT.md success-definition edit is outside this skill's single-file scope (per claim 3's finding).
